_comment: Curated description of every mirrored SDRBench dataset. 'archive' is relative to globus_base. 'rules' map file globs (matched against the file name or its path inside the variant) to a numpy dtype and a C-order shape (slowest dimension first, as in the SZ3 CI dataset table); shape "1d" means a flat array. Every non-text file must match a rule and its size must equal prod(shape)*itemsize, or the catalog build fails. A rule with dtype null marks a non-array file (HDF5, ADIOS .bp, ...).

excluded.NSTX_GPI/nstx_data_ornl_demo.bp: owner asks to be contacted before results are published; not redistributed

cesm-atm.title: CESM-ATM
cesm-atm.description: Climate simulation (Community Earth System Model, atmosphere component). 79 2D fields of 1800x3600, plus one 3D field of 26x1800x3600; single precision. The 'cleared' variant zeroes all background data.

exaalt.title: EXAALT
exaalt.description: Molecular dynamics simulation. Particle fields (x, y, z, vx, vy, vz) stored separately; single precision, little-endian.

hurricane-isabel.title: Hurricane ISABEL
hurricane-isabel.description: Weather simulation of Hurricane Isabel (WRF model), 13 fields of 100x500x500, single precision. Per-field archives hold 48 time steps; *_log10 variants are log10-transformed fields; 'cleared' fields replace the background by 0.
hurricane-isabel.source: NCAR; released for the IEEE Visualization 2004 Contest (http://vis.computer.org/vis2004contest/data.html)
hurricane-isabel.acknowledgment: Hurricane Isabel data produced by the Weather Research and Forecast (WRF) model, courtesy of NCAR, and the U.S. National Science Foundation (NSF).

exafel.title: EXAFEL
exafel.description: Images from the LCLS instrument (X-ray free-electron laser); single precision, HDF5 and binary.

hacc.title: HACC
hacc.description: Cosmology particle simulation (Hardware/Hybrid Accelerated Cosmology Code). Six particle fields (x, y, z, vx, vy, vz) stored separately as 1D arrays; single precision, little-endian. multi-timesteps/<step> holds several time steps of one region.
hacc.citation_extra: Please cite Heitmann et al., Astrophys. J. Suppl. 252 (2021) 2, 19 (https://inspirehep.net/literature/1799008) when using HACC data.

nyx.title: NYX
nyx.description: Cosmology: adaptive mesh hydrodynamics + N-body cosmological simulation. 6 fields of 512x512x512, single precision, little-endian; the _log variant holds log-transformed fields.

nwchem.title: NWChem
nwchem.description: Two-electron repulsion integrals computed over Gaussian-type orbital basis sets, generated by libint (Valeev group, Virginia Tech), an integral evaluation option in NWChemEx. 3 fields, 1D, double precision, little-endian.
nwchem.source: libint (https://github.com/evaleev/libint), Valeev research group, Virginia Tech

scale-letkf.title: SCALE-LETKF
scale-letkf.description: Weather/climate simulation from the Local Ensemble Transform Kalman Filter (LETKF) data assimilation package for the SCALE-RM model. 13 fields of 98x1200x1200, single precision, little-endian; the _log variant holds log-transformed fields.

qmcpack.title: QMCPACK
qmcpack.description: Many-body ab initio Quantum Monte Carlo (electronic structure of atoms, molecules and solids). 1 field, 288 orbitals of 115x69x69, single precision, little-endian.
qmcpack.source: QMCPACK performance test; contact Ye Luo (yeluo@anl.gov)

miranda.title: Miranda
miranda.description: Hydrodynamics code for large turbulence simulations. 7 fields of 256x384x384 (double precision), and a 3072x3072x3072 field.

s3d.title: S3D
s3d.description: Combustion simulation. 11 fields of 500x500x500, double precision, little-endian.

basilisk-turbulence.title: Basilisk-Turbulence
basilisk-turbulence.description: Decaying turbulence simulation with Basilisk (http://basilisk.fr/). Velocity fields u, v of 1501x1024x1024 and 1001x2048x2048 (time x space), single precision, little-endian.
basilisk-turbulence.source: M. Xia, Y. Li, P. Jiao, B. Wang, X. Liang and H. Guo, "Time-Varying Vector Field Compression with Preserved Critical Point Trajectories," IEEE ICDE 2026, pp. 2235-2249, doi:10.1109/ICDE65706.2026.00168

xgc.title: XGC
xgc.description: Fusion simulation (XGC gyrokinetic code). 9 time steps on an unstructured mesh (20694 nodes x 512), double precision, little-endian; the mesh is included in the archive.
